description: This PHP source file defines the MetaService class in the Api\V8\Service namespace. The class provides API endpoints for retrieving module and field metadata, as well as a Swagger schema. It interacts with other components such as BeanManager and ModuleListProvider, and handles permission checks for module access.

classes.name: MetaService
classes.description: Provides API endpoints for retrieving module list, field list, and Swagger schema for the application. Handles permission checks and data serialization.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of available modules in a structured API response format.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Returns a list of fields for a specified module, with permission checking.

methods.name: checkIfUserHasModuleAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a specified module; throws exception if not.

methods.name: buildFieldList
methods.description: Builds the list of fields for a module by retrieving its bean and pruning field definitions.

methods.name: pruneVardef
methods.description: Filters the module's vardef fields to only include allowed properties, with default settings for 'required' and 'dbType'.

methods.name: getSwaggerSchema
methods.description: Loads and returns the Swagger JSON schema from a file, throwing exceptions if the file is missing or unreadable.
